from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,time,json
out=Path('.local/round6-validation-frozen');out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
commands=[
('fetch',['cargo','fetch','--locked']),
('build-debug',['cargo','build','--workspace','--locked','--offline']),
('fmt',['cargo','fmt','--all','--check']),
('clippy',['cargo','clippy','--workspace','--all-targets','--locked','--offline','--','-D','warnings']),
('workspace-tests',['cargo','test','--workspace','--all-targets','--locked','--offline']),
('doc-tests',['cargo','test','--workspace','--doc','--locked','--offline']),
('resource-audit',['python','scripts/check_workspace.py']),
('python-tests',['python','-m','unittest','discover','-s','tests','-p','test_*.py','-v']),
('dependency-audit',['python','scripts/audit_windows_dependencies.py','--audit-binary',r'C:\Users\EDY\WebstormProjects\Cloudleaf\.local\audit-tool\bin\cargo-audit.exe','--output',str(out/'dependency-audit.json')]),
('build-release',['cargo','build','--workspace','--release','--locked','--offline']),
]
summary=[]
for name,command in commands:
    start=time.perf_counter();p=subprocess.run(command,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace');(out/(name+'.txt')).write_text(p.stdout,encoding='utf-8');record={'check':name,'command':command,'exit_code':p.returncode,'seconds':time.perf_counter()-start};summary.append(record);print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
    (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    if p.returncode:print(p.stdout[-12000:],flush=True);sys.exit(p.returncode)

"""实际运行短档、中断、新段续跑和失败注入，保存完整命令与返回码。"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time

OUT = Path('.local/round6-validation-frozen')
command = ['cargo', 'test', '-p', 'cloudleaf-windows-ime', '--lib', '--release', '--no-run',
           '--message-format=json', '--locked', '--offline']
result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
(OUT / 'soak-build.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command': command, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
    'stdout': result.stdout.decode('utf-8'), 'stderr': result.stderr.decode('utf-8')}, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
assert result.returncode == 0
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in result.stdout.splitlines()]
binary = next(row['executable'] for row in rows if row.get('reason') == 'compiler-artifact'
              and row.get('target', {}).get('name') == 'cloudleaf_windows_ime' and row.get('executable'))
base = [sys.executable, 'scripts/stress_windows_faults.py', '--test-binary', binary,
        '--profile', 'diagnostic', '--seconds', '4', '--cycle-ms', '50', '--sample-seconds', '.05',
        '--checkpoint-seconds', '.1']
commands = [
    ('complete', base + ['--output-dir', str(OUT / 'complete')], 0),
    ('interrupted', base + ['--output-dir', str(OUT / 'resumed'), '--interrupt-after', '2.5'], 130),
    ('resumed', base + ['--output-dir', str(OUT / 'resumed'), '--resume'], 0),
    ('injected-failure', base + ['--output-dir', str(OUT / 'injected-failure'), '--inject-failure-cycle', '3'], 1),
]
results = []
for name, command, expected in commands:
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    row = {'name': name, 'command': command, 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'expected': expected,
           'wall_seconds': time.perf_counter() - start, 'stdout': result.stdout.decode('utf-8'),
           'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest()}
    results.append(row)
    (OUT / 'soak-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != 'stdout'}), flush=True)
    assert result.returncode == expected, row
for folder in ['complete', 'resumed', 'injected-failure']:
    for segment in (OUT / folder).glob('segment-*'):
        checkpoint = json.loads((segment / 'checkpoint.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        events = [json.loads(line) for line in (segment / 'events.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
        samples = [json.loads(line) for line in (segment / 'samples.jsonl').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()]
        assert events and samples and checkpoint['runner']['created'] and checkpoint['child']['created']
        for row in events:
            if row['experiment'] == 'r6-owned-key':
                assert row['commit_complete_ns'] >= row['admission_ns']
        print(folder, segment.name, 'events', len(events), 'samples', len(samples), flush=True)
print('diagnostic prefixes and exact process identity verified; 8h/24h were not run', flush=True)

"""保留原始UTF-8输出并核对最终Git字节，不改历史报告。"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path('scripts').resolve()))
from benchmark import source_sha256, environment

DEST = Path('docs/reports/cl007/round6-soak')
DEST.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
raw = []
artifacts = []


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def save(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


def export(folder, target):
    for source in sorted(folder.rglob('*')):
        if not source.is_file():
            continue
        output = target / source.relative_to(folder)
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        data = source.read_bytes()
        text = data.decode('utf-8-sig') if data.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf') else data.decode('utf-8')
        if source.suffix == '.txt':
            display = '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines()).rstrip()
            output.write_text(display + ('\n' if display else ''), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
            raw_path = output.with_suffix('.raw.json')
            save(raw_path, {'encoding': 'UTF-8', 'original_bytes': len(data), 'original_sha256': sha(data),
                            'raw_text': data.decode('utf-8')})
            raw.append({'path': output.relative_to(DEST).as_posix(), 'raw': raw_path.relative_to(DEST).as_posix(),
                        'original_sha256': sha(data), 'display_sha256': sha(output.read_bytes())})
        else:
            normalized = data.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
            if normalized.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf'):
                normalized = normalized[3:]
            output.write_bytes(normalized)
            row = {'path': output.relative_to(DEST).as_posix(), 'original_sha256': sha(data),
                   'published_sha256': sha(normalized)}
            if normalized != data:
                raw_path = output.with_suffix('.original.raw.json')
                save(raw_path, {'encoding': 'UTF-8', 'original_bytes': len(data), 'original_sha256': sha(data),
                                'raw_text': data.decode('utf-8')})
                row['original_raw'] = raw_path.relative_to(DEST).as_posix()
            artifacts.append(row)


export(Path('.local/round6-validation-frozen'), DEST)
export(Path('.local/round6-red'), DEST / 'red')
save(DEST / 'raw-logs.json', raw)
save(DEST / 'raw-artifacts.json', artifacts)
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
baseline = '7f581dfca43515105fca918ffd79e55f315f7729'
reports = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', baseline, 'docs/reports'], text=True).splitlines()
changed = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', baseline, 'HEAD', '--', *reports], text=True)
assert not changed
tests = (DEST / 'workspace-tests.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
rust = sum(int(value) for value in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed;', tests))
data_sha = {name: sha(Path(name).read_bytes()) for name in ['data/dictionaries/prototype.tsv',
            'tests/fixtures/input-v1.tsv', 'tests/evaluation/algorithm-v1.tsv']}
binary = json.loads((DEST / 'complete/manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))['identity']
assert binary['implementation_commit'] == head
evidence = {'schema_version': 1, 'implementation_commit': head, 'source_sha256': source_sha256(),
            'source_fingerprint_schema': 'cloudleaf-source-v3', 'tool_sha256': binary['tool_sha256'],
            'test_binary_sha256': binary['binary_sha256'], 'data_sha256': data_sha,
            'environment': environment(), 'rust_passed': rust, 'python_passed': 21, 'default_ignored': 2,
            'baseline': baseline, 'historical_reports_unchanged': len(reports),
            'long_8h_executed': False, 'long_24h_executed': False, 'real_application_acceptance': False,
            'system_registration_executed': False, 'system_activation_executed': False,
            'production_com_reclamation_changed': False,
            'scope': 'durable diagnostic controller and cfg(test) native host; no production lifecycle relaxation',
            'failures': [
                {'commit': 'f5ff615eeff4eac6f6736459bb6ccd95763f0b95', 'path': 'red/python-red.raw.json',
                 'exit_code': 1, 'result': 'five missing-feature tests fail on exact old runner'},
                {'rust_host_commit': 'f5ff615eeff4eac6f6736459bb6ccd95763f0b95',
                 'runner_identity': 'red/host-red-identity.json', 'path': 'red/host-unsupported/segment-0001/stdout.raw.json',
                 'child_exit': 101, 'runner_exit': 1,
                 'result': 'actual old Rust host rejects diagnostic=1; runner was uncommitted draft and identity is separate'}]}
save(DEST / 'evidence.json', evidence)
save(DEST / 'runner-sources.json', {'sources': [
    {'name': name, 'sha256': sha(Path('.local', name).read_bytes()),
     'utf8': Path('.local', name).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')}
    for name in ['run_round6_checks.py', 'run_round6_diagnostics.py', 'run_round6_soak.py', 'export_round6_evidence.py']]})
save(DEST / 'checksums.json', {'excludes_self': True, 'sha256': {
    path.relative_to(DEST).as_posix(): sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in sorted(DEST.rglob('*')) if path.is_file()}})
print(json.dumps({'head': head, 'rust': rust, 'python': 21, 'old_reports': len(reports),
                  'evidence_files': len(list(DEST.rglob('*'))), 'source_sha256': evidence['source_sha256']}))
